Name: Joja Initiative
Author: zilchaz
Description:
Tweaks the introduction event and adds new events and dialogue for the [u][b][color=#6d9eeb]Joja route[/color][/b][/u].

This mod started as a little preparation for my new Joja playthrough, for those who want to [s]join the dark side[/s] join the thrive!

I'd recommend using this on a [u][b][color=#6d9eeb]new save[/color][/b][/u] and [u][b][color=#6d9eeb]not checking "Skip Intro"[/color][/b][/u], since the introduction event contains new content and dialogue.

[color=#3c78d8][size=5]Features[/size][/color]

[b][size=4]What's Changed?[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Introduction Event[/b]:
Before you meet Robin, someone approaches you with a rather unusual proposition.
(Note: This part requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20289]Aimon's Bus Interior[/url] to be installed.)
(Note 2: Do not check "Skip Intro" when creating a new character, or this event will be skipped.)[/*]
[*][b]Joja Ceremony Event[/b]:
Change Joja completed event to match the lore.[/*]
[*][b]Community Development Lore Overhaul[/b]:
Reframes Joja's town projects. Instead of the farmer single-handedly paying for everything, events and dialogue treat projects as "community-funded partnerships."
(Yes, you still pay the same amounts in-game. The difference is that the dialogue and events now treat the projects as community-funded.)
(As a result, this mod may conflict with other mods that change or add lore to the Joja route.)
[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=4]What's Added?[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Joja Membership Card[/b]: Adds a Joja Membership Card to your wallet. (It's purely aesthetic and has no abilities or gameplay functions.)[/*]
[*][b]Events & Dialogue[/b]: Adds 10+ new events for Joja Route.[/*]
[/list]

[b][color=#1155cc]Join us. Thrive.[/color][/b]
